scenarios.name: Change appearance from an expanded panel title

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the user opens the "Ribbon Appearance" submenu
"Normal" is checked and the Modify additional commands remain visible
the menus and Modify additional command area close
the ribbon displays command icons without their command labels
the user opens the Modify additional command area again
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the user opens the "Ribbon Appearance" submenu
the full ribbon displays its command labels again
the Modify additional command area remains closed
